ipa.curves.zc_curves.ValuationTime

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves.zc_curves.ValuationTime.

Syntax

ValuationTime(
    *,
    city_name: OptStr = None,
    local_time: OptStr = None,
    market_identifier_code: OptStr = None,
    time_zone_offset: OptStr = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
city_name OptStr No None The city name according to market identifier code (mic) (e.g., 'new york') see iso 10383 for reference.
local_time OptStr No None Local time or other words time in offset timezone. the value is expressed in iso 8601 format: [hh]:[mm]:[ss] (e.g., '14:00:00').
market_identifier_code OptStr No None Market identifier code (mic) is a unique identification code used to identify securities trading exchanges, regulated and non-regulated trading markets. e.g. xnas. see iso 10383 for reference.
time_zone_offset OptStr No None Time offsets from utc. the value is expressed in iso 8601 format: [hh]:[mm] (e.g., '+05:00').
